description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Declaration made by the Speaker of Parliament that the Post of the Chief Internal Auditor be a pensionable post w.e.f. 22.07.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns a declaration regarding the pensionable status of a specific post (Chief Internal Auditor) within the parliamentary staff. This falls under public sector administration, specifically service conditions and benefits for public servants, which is the domain of Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes). While it involves a government body (Parliament), the content is not about structural changes (Type 1), a named individual's appointment (Type 2), or a hybrid of both (Type 3). It is a procedural administrative matter for public service staff.
